messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Severity: P1 - elevated error rate and token surge on embeds_v2 route (us-east-1). Detected spike in 1m QPS, affecting some high-volume customers. Auto-scaling triggered but hitting GPU packing limits.

alex: saw it, paging oncall. i'm on it.

maria: copying quick context — embeddings route is dominated by a single partner job, 90% of traffic. latency up from 50ms -> 700ms tail.

alex: can we throttle that partner first? set per-customer cap for now.

satoshi: agree. recommend immediate per-endpoint quota tweak: set embeds_v2 route to 60% global cap, and carve 10% reserved for chat routes.

maria: proposed steps:
- short-term: apply per-customer soft cap (partner X) and reduce overall embeds_v2 concurrency 2->1 per GPU slot
- mid-term: enable route-level token-sculpting (favor chat tokens)
- longer: investigate why partner job bypassed batching/caching

alex: implementing short-term now. applying soft cap to partner X (org-4321).

julie: tagging support — FYI customers on Partner X may see failed embed requests; prepare standard customer note.

incident-bot: Action logged: rate-limit-change by alex @ 2629000245.

alex: command run: `redwoodctl quotas update --route embeds_v2 --org org-4321 --max-requests-per-min 1200`

maria: also did a global per-endpoint adjustment: `redwoodctl quotas update --route embeds_v2 --global-share 0.60` (applied to us-east-1).

jonathan: I'm taking next shift (handoff). summary?

alex: summary: applied org soft-cap, global 60% share for embeds_v2 in us-east-1, rerank endpoints untouched for now. traffic shifted to chat-friendly routing, enabled fallback to smaller quantized model for embeddings when latency>400ms.

jonathan: noted. any customer impact metrics?

satoshi: initial numbers: errors from affected partner dropped from 12% -> 3% after cap. overall embeddings qps down 30%. chat tail latency improved 20%.

julie: drafted ephemeral status msg for impacted customers. keeps it brief: "We're limiting high-volume embedding jobs temporarily to restore platform stability; some embed requests may be delayed or throttled."

alex: also turned off non-critical rerank feature on route /v1/rerank-experimental to free capacity. command: `redwoodctl feature-flag set rerank-experimental off`

maria: leaving traffic-shape rule active for next 2 hours, then re-evaluate. recorded rollback plan: revert global-share to 1.0 and remove org cap once partner reduces job frequency.

jonathan: i'll monitor overnight. if tail>500ms for chat or errors >5% we escalate to infra. set alerts: chat_tail_ms > 500, embed_err_rate > 5%.

incident-bot: Pager handoff recorded: alex -> jonathan @ 2629000320.

julie: support note queued; outreach to top-3 impacted customers started.

satoshi: postmortem items:
- enforce per-org quota ceilings for embedding jobs at infra level
- add detection that flags single-customer dominance on a route
- improve autoscaler heuristics for packing GPUs with mixed seq lengths

jonathan: acknowledged. will create incident ticket with action items and owners.

alex: one more: add temporary canary for routing change to eu-west to avoid global regressions — will push in an hour if stable.

maria: thanks all. good quick coordination. keep notes in the incident board. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: taking point, will post periodic updates.

incident-bot: Thread closed for updates? (react with :lock: to close)
